about: Target = goal, limit = hard ceiling. value <= target: PASS, <= limit: WARN, above: FAIL. Basis and sources in docs/PERFORMANCE.md.

audio_block_max_pct_deadline.basis: one voice's worst block; leaves room for the other voices

late_mix.basis: mix callback later than expected gap

main_peak_us_max.basis: slowest _process: no hitch above a quarter / half frame at 60 fps

main_us_per_player.basis: 32 players within ~0.5 ms main-thread budget need ~15 us each

spawn_us_max.basis: add_child + play of one player must not hitch a frame (estimate)

stream_static_pack_us_max.basis: streaming a static pack in or out must not stall a 60 fps frame

stream_probe_batch_us_max.basis: adding or removing a probe volume must not stall a 60 fps frame

material_swap_us_max.basis: assigning a material to live geometry must not stall a 60 fps frame

worker_cpu_pct.basis: Steam Audio default: one simulation thread

reflections_us_max.basis: must fit the 0.1 s reflections interval

scene_commit_us_max.basis: runtime commits must not exceed a frame

audio_us_per_voice_block.basis: raw Steam Audio binaural+direct 5-9 us at 512 frames

nexus_overhead_us_per_voice_block.basis: block minus Steam Audio effect apply; measured ~25 us (direct path ~16 us)

audio_us_per_voice_block.basis: sources only send; cost as direct_8

idle_main_delta_us.basis: stopped players should be near free (main CPU per frame)

voice_scaling_ratio.basis: per-voice cost should stay flat with more voices

inaudible_voice_cost_ratio.basis: inaudible voices should cost less than audible ones

static_scene_worker_ratio.basis: unchanged input need not be simulated again
